items.title: AMEX exits, Palo Alto Networks steps in to sponsor La Quinta PGA Tour event
items.why: Amex's exit opens a sponsorship slot at a PGA event that a premium card issuer could target for cardholder experiences.
items.summary_ai: American Express is leaving sponsorship of the La Quinta PGA Tour event, and Palo Alto Networks is stepping in as its replacement.
items.take: Amex's exit opens a sponsorship slot at a PGA event that a premium card issuer could target for cardholder experiences.
